projection: fixed bird-eye view for geometric comparison
bounds_rule: Choose once from the raw source sequence; persist and reuse for all methods. Do not crop each output independently.
frame_rule: Explicit provided teaser entries; show original filenames. Do not imply full consecutive KITTI sampling.

video_target.preview: gif or PNG, with a link to the full video

sampling_rule: Compute metrics before display thinning; save fixed seed and identical point selection per comparison.
metric_scope: Specify full sequence / frame / ROI separately. Never label display-thinned counts as full evaluation.
label_rule: Use scored point identities. Distinguish output-map NN, segment API and GT; never silently mix them.
offline_rule: Author cleaned maps use all provided frames; replay is visualization of an offline output, not causal online inference.
language_rule: Both editions share geometry/data. Captions are independent; optional localized overlays must be generated from the same config.
